age_sex.source: United Nations, DESA, Population Division, World Population Prospects 2024 (CC BY 3.0 IGO), Viet Nam (LocID 704), single-year-of-age population by sex, as distributed in the UN Population Division's official R data package wpp2024 v1.1-3 (2024-11-26): popAge1dt (estimates 1949-2023) and popprojAge1dt (medium variant 2024-2100).
age_sex.url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PPgp/wpp2024/main/data/popAge1dt.rda ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PPgp/wpp2024/main/data/popprojAge1dt.rda ; https://github.com/PPgp/wpp2024 ; official page https://population.un.org/wpp (blocked from sandbox)
age_sex.edition: UN WPP 2024 (released 11 Jul 2024); estimates to 2023, medium-variant projection from 2024
age_sex.ref_date: 31 December of each year (WPP 2024 civil-calendar stock, i.e. 1 January of the following year) - NOT 1 July. Not averaged or interpolated.
age_sex.top_band: 80+ = sum of single ages 80-99 plus the open 100+ group
age_sex.note: One source for every year (UN WPP 2024); no NSO values are mixed in. 5-year bands are plain sums of the official single-age values. Years 2025-2050 are PROJECTIONS (medium variant); 2000-2023 are WPP estimates (modelled by the UN from censuses/surveys, not NSO counts). Totals differ from WPP's 1 July series (e.g. 2025: 101.897 m here at 31 Dec vs 101.599 m at 1 July) and from NSO average population (2025p: 102.345 m). NSO cross-check (broad ages, from NSO press-release excerpts via web search; pages not fetchable): census 1/4/2019 0-14 24.0%, 15-64 68.4%, 65+ 7.6% (WPP 31 Dec 2019: 24.48/68.12/7.40); mid-term census 1/4/2024 23.3/67.4/9.3 (WPP 31 Dec 2023: 23.43/67.74/8.82; 31 Dec 2024 not stored). WPP's sex ratio (~96 males per 100 females) is lower than NSO's (census 2019: 99.1; 1/4/2024: 99.2 from 50,346,030 M / 50,766,626 F) - label the chart 'UN WPP 2024'. POP_SERIES.gso.age_2050 is a different source (GSO 2019-2069 projection: 65+ 18.81% in 2050 vs WPP 20.27%); do not combine. NSO 5-year age-sex tables (census 2019 / DSGK 1/4/2024) were not reachable (nso.gov.vn, gso.gov.vn, vietnam.unfpa.org blocked) - preferred replacement for the estimate years when a runner can reach them. 2026-10-09: single years 2017-2030 added from the same files (popAge1dt to 2023, popprojAge1dt medium from 2024) so the 2018-2030 frames are annual; recomputed bands match the held years exactly (2019, 2020, 2023, 2025, 2030).

un_annual.label: PROJECTION from 2024. UN WPP 2024, Viet Nam, total population at 31 December of each year (= 1 January of the next year), million persons
un_annual.ref_date: 31 December (NOT 1 July). Do not splice with POP_SERIES.un (1 July, 5-year points) or POP_SERIES.actual (NSO average population).
un_annual.source: UN DESA Population Division, World Population Prospects 2024, official R data package wpp2024 v1.1-3 (2024-11-26): popAge1dt (estimates, summed over single ages) and popprojAge1dt/popproj1dt (projections).
un_annual.note: Same edition as POP_SERIES.un, but a different reference date: the 1 July annual series (UN CSV) is on population.un.org, blocked from the sandbox, so 1 July single years 2026-2029 are NOT filled (no interpolation). Check: 31 Dec 2025 = 101.897 m vs 1 July 2025 = 101.599 m (POP_SERIES.un.medium). medium = POP_SERIES.age_sex.total_thousand / 1000.

nat_series.ref: Vital rates refer to the 12 months before the 1 April population-change survey of each year (census 1/4/2019; mid-term census 1/4/2024); urban % and growth from average population.
nat_series.source: NSO PX-Web (fetched 2026-10-04 by tools/build/demo/build.py; cache tools/build/demo/demo.json): V02.15 (TFR), V02.08 (SRB), V02.24 (life expectancy), V02.02 (urban share, growth), V02.11 (CBR, CDR)
nat_series.note: National only; provincial rates are not re-aggregated to the 34 units (user decision 2026-10-07). 2024 values equal POP_SERIES.nat; 2025 equal POP_SERIES.nat_latest (SRB 2025: PX V02.08 110.0 vs NSO Jan-2026 press excerpt 109.0, unresolved). Life expectancy steps 73.64 (2022) -> 74.5 (2023) with the new life table; not a one-year gain. Urban % 2019->2020 jump follows reclassification of urban areas.

wb_crosscheck.note: World Bank WDI (values = UN WPP 2024 estimates; urban = UN WUP) - a different source; for comparison only, never mixed into the NSO arrays.

history_wdi.note: Older WDI vintage than now/prev (July 2026): 2020 here 37/209 vs held prev 37/210. 2024 missing.

g_gdp_pc.label: GDP per capita (current US$)
g_gdp_pc.source: https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/all/indicator/NY.GDP.PCAP.CD?format=json (WDI July-2026 update; rank among WB economies excluding aggregates; 1 = highest; of = economies with data that year)

history_imf.source: IMF World Economic Outlook April 2026 (NGDPDPC), DataMapper API cache tools/build/grdp/imf_NGDPDPC.json (fetched 2026-10-05); October 2026 WEO due 13/10/2026 - refresh then
history_imf.basis: rank among IMF DataMapper countries (groups excluded); 1 = highest; of = countries with data that year
history_imf.note: IMF, not World Bank: values and ranks differ from now/prev (WDI). 2026-2030 are projections (draw dashed).

g_gdp_pc.history_gap: WDI yearly ranks not reachable (api.worldbank.org blocked); IMF WEO ranks given in history_imf.
